faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Whatever you like! Just don’t blame us if you get cold or your shoes get muddy in the garden.

faqs.question: How do I get there?
faqs.answer: You will find directions to the villa below. If you have questions or need help planning your journey, just write to us!

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog?
faqs.answer: Sorry, Akamaru will be the only four-legged guest at the wedding. Please leave your furry friends at home.

faqs.question: What can I give you?
faqs.answer: Actually, we would like to turn the question around: what can we give you for all the effort you will make to be here with us? So please don’t expect a wedding list, bank details or a box for envelopes. We have everything we need, thank you! We know that for some of you, being here means arranging a trip, taking time off and making sacrifices. The best gift you can give us is sharing this day with us. Don’t miss it!

faqs.question: Where can I park?
faqs.answer: Villa Valentina has supervised parking on site, so leave your car at the villa and enjoy the day.

faqs.question: Where can I stay overnight?
faqs.answer: We do not know the area well enough to recommend accommodation yet. There are not many places around Tradate; write to us if you need a hand finding somewhere.
